articles.title: North Korea fires ballistic missiles off eastern coast, Seoul says
articles.summary: North Korea fired several ballistic missiles towards the sea off its eastern coast, detected by South Korea's Joint Chiefs of Staff. This launch is a recurring display of Pyongyang's military capabilities and defiance of international sanctions. Such tests typically escalate regional tensions and are often seen as responses to joint military exercises, posing ongoing security challenges for its neighbours.

articles.title: foxguard v0.13.0
articles.summary: Foxguard provides fast, local security scanning for software code, secrets, dependencies, and crypto risks. Integrated with the 0sec open cybersecurity harness, it helps identify vulnerabilities early. This tool is crucial for enhancing software integrity, reducing exploitation risks, and ensuring robust digital infrastructure, which is vital for both civilian and defence applications in the modern technological landscape.

articles.title: Marengo Asia Hospitals raises Rs 400 crore from LeapFrog Investments to double bed capacity
articles.summary: Marengo Asia Hospitals has successfully raised ₹400 crore from LeapFrog Investments to facilitate a significant expansion of its hospital network. This strategic investment, supported by Samara Capital, aims to enhance healthcare infrastructure and accessibility across India. The funding highlights a push to strengthen national health services through private sector growth and development.
